name: PNG (Portable Network Graphics)

technical_body.chunk_grammar: length(4) + type(4) + data(length) + crc(4); each chunk type's first letter case flags ancillary/private/reserved/safe-to-copy
technical_body.private_chunk_convention: second letter lowercase (e.g. `stEg`) — parsers preserve unknown chunks by default

notes: PNG's chunk grammar is the most stego-friendly of the common image formats. Named text chunks are stripped by some sanitizers; private chunks slip through most (see Slack survival for the exact case).

name: JPEG (baseline / progressive)

technical_body.marker_grammar: SOI (FFD8), APPn (FFE0..FFEF, EXIF/XMP live here), DQT (FFDB), DHT (FFC4), SOF0/SOF2 (FFC0/FFC2), SOS (FFDA), EOI (FFD9)
technical_body.block_structure: 8×8 DCT blocks, zig-zag ordered, per-quantization-table scaled
technical_body.dct_targets_for_stego: AC coefficients only; DC coefficients are too perceptually loaded

notes: F5 / jsteg / OutGuess all embed in quantized AC DCT coefficients. Every re-quantization pass (Slack CDN, WhatsApp photo mode, JPEG->JPEG at different Q) is a threat to the payload.

name: GIF (Graphics Interchange Format)

technical_body.block_grammar: Logical Screen Descriptor + Global Color Table + Image Descriptors + Extension Blocks (0x21) + Trailer (0x3B)

notes: GIF87a/89a. Palette-indexed with per-palette LSB steg viable. Comment extensions are the equivalent of PNG tEXt chunks.

name: WAV / RIFF (PCM audio)

technical_body.chunk_grammar: RIFF header + fmt chunk (PCM parameters) + data chunk (raw samples) + optional LIST/INFO chunks
steg_targets: LSB of PCM samples (1-3 bits per sample tolerable)

notes: PCM WAV is the audio analogue of a lossless bitmap. LSB per-sample survives byte-identical transfers and dies to any lossy re-encode (MP3, AAC).

name: PCAP (packet capture)

technical_body.magic_bytes: D4 C3 B2 A1 or A1 B2 C3 D4 (endian-flipped)
technical_body.frame_grammar: PCAP global header + per-packet timestamp/caplen/wirelen + Ethernet/IP/TCP/UDP payload

notes: Every field the RFC doesn't nail down to a single value is a potential steg carrier. See network_core for the specific fields ST3GG's encoder writes.

name: UTF-8 plain text
notes: The universal text carrier. Every text-steg method operates on UTF-8 codepoints; the only variation is which codepoint class carries the bits.
